finalText:
Wrote the handoff to `INCIDENT_HANDOFF.md`. It covers root cause, the full cascade timeline, and impact window.

One thing to flag on the ioredis version: there's no `package-lock.json` in this repo, so I couldn't pin down the exact installed build. `package.json` only declares `^5.4.1`, which covers anything up to 6.0.0. Run `npm ls ioredis` on the live instance to get the real number before you check it against the changelog.
